newsitem.title: USA: NGC post-deal assets in $300-$325 mln range.
newsitem.headline: NGC post-deal assets in $300-$325 mln range.

text.p: NGC Corp said Monday that the net cost of the assets to be retained by the company after its deal with Destec Energy Inc is completed is estimated to be in the range of $300 to $325 million, after the sale of certain non-strategic assets.
The amount was originally estimated to be about $400 million, NGC said.

NGC issued a news release saying it closed the acquisition of Destec and the related sale of most of Destec's international projects and operations to AES Corporation for $407 million, subject to certain adjustments.
Destec Energy will retain its name and operate as a subsidiary of NGC, the news release said.

"Although we have sold most of Destec's international assets because they are not strategic to our interests, NGC will pursue an international strategy for the power generation business with those remaining assets, as well as future opportunities," NGC said.
